title: E4 IDOR (any caller reads any order by id): a blocking HIGH or CRIT at the missing owner check, label recorded (D-0110)
ticket: Customers need to open one of their own orders: add GET /orders/:id. Until login lands, the caller is the X-User-Id header.

findings.problem: GET /orders/:id returns any order to any caller: OrdersController.get passes only the id to OrdersService.get, which loads the order by id and never compares order.userId with req.callerId. CallerGuard authenticates, nothing authorizes (IDOR, OWASP A01).
findings.failure_scenario: Caller X-User-Id: 3 sends GET /orders/16, an order of user 4: 200 with user 4's order. Walking ids 1..250 reads every customer's orders.
findings.fix: Pass req.callerId to OrdersService.get and load with where {id, userId: callerId} (findFirst), 404 when not found; add an e2e test: another user's order answers 404.

notes: CallerGuard answers 401 for a missing or non-numeric X-User-Id; the e2e tests cover 200, 401 and 404 for the owner only.
